oracle.oracle_note: The rule is TypeScript loaded through the repository's own build toolchain, which needs a full `npm ci` of the VS Code repo. It was NOT executed here. The decision procedure was re-implemented from `.eslint-plugin-local/code-layering.ts` and `utils.ts` at the pinned SHA; the layer table is verified against `eslint.config.js` at run time (config_check).

seeded.injection_policy: one injection per file, only in files where the native scan and limen's discovery glob assign the SAME layer, so this arm measures rule agreement and not the D-VSC-1 discovery gap

layer_assignment.deviation: D-VSC-1: the native rule scans directory segments right to left and SKIPS segments that are not configured layers; limen binds {layer} to the rightmost segment and then drops it if it is not declared. Files whose layer directory is not the immediate parent therefore get no layer in limen and are not checked.
